newsitem.title: REPUBLIC OF IRELAND: McCreevy bookmaker's favourite to be next finmin.
newsitem.headline: McCreevy bookmaker's favourite to be next finmin.

text.p: Ireland's Paddy Power bookmakers have made Charlie McCreevy 11/10 favourite to be finance minister after Friday's election.
McCreevy is finance spokesman for the opposition Fianna Fail party who have consistently headed the opinion polls with their Progressive Democrat allies since campaigning started.
Paddy Power gave current finance minister, Labour's Ruairi Quinn, odds of 13/8 on retaining his job.

The bookmaker offered odds of 10/1 and 14/1 respectively on Fine Gael's Hugh Coveney and Richard Bruton taking the finance brief while Progressive Democrat finance spokesman Michael McDowell received odds of 50/1.
